title: This Might Offend You… But the Black Church Isn’t Helping

top_liked.author: @hamptontanguero
top_liked.text: I've wondered this very same thing. The black community is one of the most dedicated Christian communities on the planet, and Christianity was used to justify keeping them in chains for 400 years.

top_liked.text: NOTHING has held Mankind back more than belief in gods!!!

top_liked.text: Yes, this is so true. Foundational Black Americans have been some of the most faithful people to religion and that book but that’s not working out for us. B1❤
